name: mem_profile
description: A first pass over a memory file's header and a sample of its bytes, before anything is run against it. Names the container only when the header says so (Windows crash dump with its physical-memory run list, checked for order, overlap and payload size; LiME with every range it frames; hibernation file; ELF core with its byte order from e_ident; AVML by its first four bytes), and says "unrecognised" for anything else, which is what a flat capture looks like and also what a file that is not memory looks like. It is not validation: it does not decode hibernation or AVML framing, does not enumerate an ELF core's segments, and does not establish the architecture, the captured ranges or the completeness of a capture. Operating-system and structure hints are signature counts in a sample of the head, middle and tail (sampled_ranges lists the bytes actually read, each range scanned on its own), not counts for the file. file_pages_4k_estimate is the file length over 4096, not a count of captured pages. A crash dump's SystemTime is given raw (system_time_filetime, 100 ns ticks since 1601-01-01 UTC) beside the ISO 8601 time with its seven fractional digits, and a value that is not a time (past the year 9999) is named in problems with its raw value, not turned into null. The two strings it reads from the capture as text are shown only when they have the grammar of a version: kernel_build is the kernel release (the first word after 'Linux version ', digits, dots and a few short words) and version_user a Windows build string; anything else is not printed (kernel_build_withheld, version_user_withheld) and the banner around a release is never printed, kernel_build_offset says where it is. It samples once for every hint and stops its sampling at 200 s (status partial, scan_stopped_at); a signal ends it with one JSON answer (status interrupted, exit 128 plus the signal). Every answer carries status and status_basis; complete means the header was read and the sampled ranges were scanned, not that the capture is valid. LiME ranges that are out of order or overlap are named in problems.

path.description: The memory image, dump or hibernation file

scan_mb.description: How many megabytes to sample for operating-system and structure hints (default 64, at most 4096); the answer lists the ranges actually read
